post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The exp-20260824-002 / exp-20260826-001 readiness gate blocked a whole batch whenever any ticker appeared on both the negative (long) and positive (short) side. The exposure rows come from sic_peer_index peer expansion, so one negative and one positive event of the same peer group in the same batch place the entire group (semiconductors 23-33 tickers, autos 17, China internet / AI software 14-20) on both sides; 10 of 33 lifetime batches and 6 of the 14 batches since 2026-09-14 were blocked that way, and under the exp-20260923-004 v2 borrow rule overlap was the ONLY remaining blocker on those 6 (exactly the failure mode exp-20260923-004 pre-registered). Removing the overlap tickers from both sides leaves both residual sides non-empty (long 19-35 / short 25-81 tickers) with max row weight <= 0.087 against the 0.40 cap, so excluding and recording them (same renormalisation pattern as the priceability and no-borrow exclusions) keeps the gate outcome-blind, keeps all 33 persisted records byte-identical (33/33 rebuilt) and lifts the hypothetical ready count from 18/33 to 25/33 lifetime and from 8/14 to 14/14 since 09-14 (20 ready decision dates).
